page.overview:
What is Mickey Mouse?

Mickey Mouse is a sub-theme of Disney introduced in 2000 based on the eponymous character. In the original sets, the majority of parts were from the Fabuland theme and the figures in the sets were to the same scale as Fabuland figures.
